moments.label: SABBATH MORNING CLASS: If Thou Come to Serve the Lord

points: Honour thy father and thy mother in law, which are now thy parents. Those are your parents. So when they get sick, who has got to take care of them? You do, because those are your parents. You are one flesh. These are your parents too now, you have got to take care of them too. So you cannot be selfish, you cannot have that bad relationship with your in-laws. Now go fix it. Go fix your situation, go fix the relationship you have with them.

Me and my wife and her parents are cool, but we had never really just sat down and chilled like that. One time me and my wife came over and just hung out, had a little drink with the in-laws, and it was cool. I thought maybe that was just because she was there. So one time I did a job out where they were at, and I said I am going to stop by by myself and see what happens. I thought it was going to be awkward. I stopped by and they were so excited. We had a conversation. I did not have the kids, I did not have my wife with me, and they were like, this dude really cares enough to stop by. That is a different ballgame. They looked at me different, like, that is really my son now — not some man that my daughter just married and then joined some type of cult. I could see it on their faces, the conversation, the constant smiling and laughing.

So I understood it: those are my parents now, I have got to treat them as such. I have got to make sure they are okay. She needs something fixed, all right, I am on my way to go fix it. You need something moved, okay, call me, I will come move it. Those are my parents.

But he is going to set variance between that, because some of you are not going to believe that. Or maybe you might be the one to try to fix it and they do not want it, because you keep the commandments. They say, nah, I am not messing with you — and you might lose the relationship behind it. Maybe you were all cool, and when you come into the truth now your in-laws or even your mother do not want to deal with you any more. Now you have got issues, and you probably will not be able to repair that unless they repent. You have got to understand that is what the Bible is saying: I came to divide all of that, because everybody is not going to understand like you all.

That is why it is a blessing to see a family come into the truth — a whole family, husband, wife, brothers and sisters coming in. That is a beautiful thing. If I could just get one family member to come into the truth I would be so happy.

And a man's foes shall be they of his own household. Your own enemies are going to be your own household. Those are the people you are going to be going back and forth with. You thought things were going to be smooth, and now you hate each other because you want to keep the commandments, you want change, you are telling them about themselves. Daddy, stop eating the pork, there are beef ribs out here now. No, I want that pork, I want that bacon, I want the shrimp. I want all of the unhealthy stuff that is killing us, I want it all.
